table.name: TLGNF_ORDER_FINAL
table.description: Frozen data of an order at the time it is set to 'finished', i.e. transition from status 15=delivered to status 16=finished . For truck orders, this is the same moment when also sending the order data to SAP. For rail orders sending to SAP happens earlier (to transmit the transportation request to the rail company via SAP), but the freeze of order data happens at the end still. The purpose of the table is to provide a snapshot of all relevant objects and their attributes at the time the order was completed, i.e. including address data of the business partners, load limits of the vehicles, optimial transport type as entered on the Dispokarte at that moment, etc. The data can then be used as a source for advanced reporting and statistics (currently outside of Logon).
